_pdfjs_dist_note: Exact-pinned, no caret, on purpose - this is NOT actually imported by any Node/build code (like pdf-lib, GUIDON vendors a pre-built browser bundle from it directly into src/index.html; see that vendoring comment and src/pdfjs-defer.js). It's listed here only for provenance (npm audit/ls, a documented source for re-vendoring), so a routine `npm install` must never silently pick up a newer pdfjs-dist without a matching, deliberate re-vendor of the pasted bundle. Pinned to 3.11.174 specifically: the last release with a classic plain-<script>-tag "legacy" global-script build (v4+ is ES-module-only) - carries GHSA-wgrm-67xf-hhpq (fixed upstream in 4.2.67+, which dropped that build), mitigated in-app via isEvalSupported:false (see openPdfPreview() in js/counselpdf.js and the vendoring comment in src/index.html for the full tradeoff).
_overrides_note: uuid pinned above GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (moderate, buffer bounds check) - the only place it appears is xcode, pulled in transitively by @capacitor/cli for iOS project-file tooling this project never invokes (no ios: scripts, cap add ios never run). npm audit fix --force would instead downgrade @capacitor/cli itself to 8.4.2, a real breaking change to touch for code that's never exercised; this pins just the vulnerable leaf instead.
